0: Every run starts with a task. Here every agent can run on a different provider.
1: The Router starts. Its provider is Groq.
3: The Router chooses one specialist and gives a reason.
4: The handoff starts only the chosen specialist, on the provider of its own slot (here Gemini).
5: The specialist starts and sees the task. Look at its colour: it is another provider than the Router.
8: The run ends. The statistics show tokens split by provider.
